sections.title: Compatibility of questions, estimands, designs and outcome scales

missing_pieces.duty: ED26-METHOD-evidence-synthesis-C02 (partial): The success condition is met for the weights, heterogeneity and interval procedures. For two selected procedures, however, the claim that the stated dependence or common-effect assumption yields the stated conclusion is asserted rather than derived, because the owed proof steps are not written. (1) thm:p15-synthesis-linear (body lines 143-146) asserts that a_*^T Y +/- z sqrt(V_*) is an exact 1-alpha interval when Y is 'multivariate normal' with known general covariance. 'Multivariate normal' is not defined anywhere on the handbook route. Annex lines 52-55 prove normality of the weighted combination only for independent estimates (via thm:p15-normal-sums) and dispose of the dependent case with 'the covariance representation gives the general case', which is a sketch. (2) thm:p15-synthesis-table-delta (body lines 274-275) asserts that the Mantel-Haenszel risk-ratio estimate is consistent under a common risk ratio. Annex lines 149-150 discharge this 'by the same argument' without writing the risk-ratio limiting sums or the summand-ratio step, which is a 'similarly' step.
